args.message: Across all orders, the average order value is about 66.33. North (about 67.78) is the only named region above it; East, South and West are all close to 65.3–65.8. Orders whose customer has no known region are grouped under null and have the highest average, about 74.58. Average order value is total order amount divided by the number of orders. Orders of every status are included, both "ok" and "bad".
